snippet.title: Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege - Official Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Take a look at the Reveal Trailer for Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege, an upcoming 2D side-scrolling action game developed by Lillymo Games. Players will assume the role of Rudiger, an ex-soldier who comes back into his old ways to defend the people against an angry priest on a power trip to steal treasures across the Holy Roman Empire. 

Dispatch a suite of enemies across 21 stages, attain upgrades, and take out seven powerful bosses alone or with friends in two-player co-op. Become the Saint Slayer in Saint Slayer: Spear of Sacrilege, launching in Early 2026 for PlayStation, Xbox, Nintendo Switch, and PC (Steam), with a demo available now on Steam.

#SaintSlayer #Retro #Platformer
